verdict.rationale: Graphite documents AI agents that open draft PRs and custom rules that configure agent behavior, but there is no evidence of a versioning system, audit trail, or rollback mechanism specifically for these automations/agent configurations themselves — only that agent-created PRs go through the normal PR flow. Missing for 10: evidence of version history for custom rules/agent configs, an explicit rollback/undo mechanism for automations, and any audit log tying automation changes to specific versions.
